title: The Night Jacob Held On
themeTags: holding on to God in the dark
God stays with us at night
God is close when we feel alone
reflectionQuestion: Jacob was alone and afraid in the dark, but he held on to God all night long — and God stayed right there with him until morning. When the dark feels a little scary, what helps you feel safe again?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jacob's New Name, Genesis 32:22-32). Mood=anxious. FEELING-FIRST: afraid + alone in the dark. EDITORIAL CHOICE (Adam-approved): told as HOLDING ON through the night, NOT wrestling/fighting. Hip-touch/limp omitted (subtraction). Indelible image: holding on until morning; new name Israel.
